# AFSIS1

Soil spectral library from Africa Soil Information Service (AfSIS) Phase I

## Overview

- **Sample size:** 1,000+
- **Version:** first release (v1)
- **Spectral range:** mir
- **Extent:** continental

## Soil laboratory information

- **n properties available:** 23
- **n properties standardized:** 20
- **n properties harmonized:** pending
- **properties themes:** physical, chemical, carbon & nutrients, metal elements

## Soil site information

- **coordinates precision:** precise, country
- **sampling depth:** various
- **geography:** soil taxonomy, landuse

## MIR

- **Acquisition mode:** Not available
- **Intensity:** absorbance
- **Original range:** 602-4000
- **Standardized range:** 600-4000
- **Instrument:** Tensor 27 FT-IR
- **Manufacturer:** Bruker Optics
- **Scan accessory:** Not available
- **Sample preparation:** Finely ground <0.1 mm
- **Additional info:** Not available
